item.title: IAF Presses Industry for Autonomous Drone Dominance
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The Indian Air Force is betting big on autonomy. At a high-stakes New Delhi outreach, IAF laid out its blueprint for indigenous drones, forcing MSMEs and startups to step up or miss the defense transition.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The strategy prioritizes layered, networked drone families to complement crewed combat aircraft across contested borders. [SPLIT] ⚡ Critical technological bottlenecks include indigenous propulsion units, autonomous edge-computing software, and jamming-resistant navigation. item.title: India Issues Urgent Security Advisory for Citizens Across France Amid Unrest
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
With over 2,400 arrests and violent clashes spreading across Paris, Marseille, and Lyon, the Indian Embassy has issued a strict advisory for citizens in France to avoid large gatherings and monitor local transit updates.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Protests originating from student grievances over overcrowded schools have expanded into widespread anti-government demonstrations driven by inflation and living costs. [SPLIT] ⚡ Localized curfews and public gathering restrictions have been enforced in major cities including Paris, Lyon, Lille, Nice, and Marseille.
